verdict.rationale: llamafile's entire value proposition is a single self-contained executable that avoids container orchestration entirely (docs-18: 'without complex infra, container orchestration, or heavy setup'; docs-14 contrasts it with client-server tools like Ollama), and no evidence pack item documents an official Docker image, Dockerfile, or container deployment guide. Community commentary (comm-10) even highlights the lack of a Dockerfile as a contrast point versus containerized alternatives. missing for 10: any official Docker/container image, Dockerfile, or containerized deployment documentation, and any first-party guidance on running llamafile inside a container.
